items.scene: A community restored a damaged wetland. Bird numbers rose over the next two years. A report attributes the rise entirely to the restoration, although nearby farms also reduced pesticide use during that period. The project may have helped, but the report provides no comparison with an unrestored site.
items.answer: The report does not rule out another explanation for the increase.
options: The report does not rule out another explanation for the increase.
The bird counts must have been invented.
Pesticides certainly caused the whole change.
items.why: Pesticide use changed at the same time, so the report has not isolated restoration as the cause.
items.hint: Separate what the text says from what you can only guess.
